name: UTM Zone 32N forward and inverse (ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N — EPSG::25832)

source.page: EPSG registry + EPSG Geomatics Guidance Note 7-2 §1.3.5 (Transverse Mercator)
source.notes: Transverse Mercator (UTM), central meridian 9°E, latitude of origin 0°, false easting 500000 m, false northing 0 m, scale factor 0.9996, GRS80 ellipsoid (ETRS89 realization). Input geographic is ETRS89 (EPSG:4258) — functionally WGS84 at the centimetre level. Frozen from pyproj EPSG:4326 → EPSG:25832 (E=798609.5209, N=5825756.2420) validated against sidecar Snyder (diff 0.0002 m).

cases.name: Berlin (52.5°N, 13.4°E → UTM 32N)
cases.notes: Berlin vicinity (52.5N,13.4E is west of CM 15 for 33N, so 32N with CM 9 gives large easting). Cross-checked with pyproj EPSG:4326 → EPSG:25832.

roundtrip_test.description: Forward then inverse must reproduce the input geographic coordinates to within 1e-7 deg (~1 cm).
